title: fsaverage cortical and subcortical anatomy
template: FreeSurfer fsaverage from MNE fsaverage-1.1, sampled onto fsaverage5 topology
atlas: Desikan–Killiany (aparc), 34 cortical parcels per hemisphere; aseg deep structures
coordinates: FreeSurfer surface/tkReg RAS in millimeters: x right, y anterior, z superior. No individual mesh translation or scaling applied.
geometryType: Actual template geometry, processed for interactive display. This file is a modified derivative, not an original FreeSurfer distribution.

cortex.template: MNE fsaverage-1.1 pial coordinates on fsaverage5 topology
cortex.labelScheme: Desikan–Killiany aparc. unknown and corpuscallosum are non-parcel labels. atlasLabelNames stored per hemisphere.
cortex.annotationTransfer: Labels from fsaverage aparc copied at exactly matching spherical vertices. Verified both fsaverage5 sphere coordinates equal fsaverage sphere coordinates at indices 0–10241, with zero coordinate error.
cortex.geometrySource: fsaverage/surf/lh.pial and rh.pial, vertices 0–10241; same MNE release as aseg and aparc labels. fsaverage5 sphere coordinates and topology determine downsampling; original MNE fsaverage pial coordinates preserve registration.

deep.processing: Binary aseg labels; Gaussian smoothing sigma 0.65 voxels; marching cubes level 0.5; main connected component; quadric mesh simplification. Cerebellum combines cortex and white-matter labels.
deep.transform: MGH header vox2ras_tkr; same fsaverage RAS coordinate frame as pial surfaces.

caveats: Population-average template, not an individual human brain.
Anatomical parcels do not uniquely define functional areas or cognitive modules.
Simplified surface boundaries are for exploration, not measurement or clinical targeting.
Hemisphere separation, opacity, or display scaling in a viewer are presentation operations; original vertices in this asset remain registered.

Hypothalamus, basal forebrain, locus coeruleus, raphe, subthalamic nucleus, and substantia nigra are not resolved by these source segmentations; any displayed proxies must be explicitly labeled schematic.

references.title: Desikan et al. (2006). An automated labeling system for subdividing the human cerebral cortex on MRI scans into gyral based regions of interest.
Fischl et al. (1999). High-resolution intersubject averaging and a coordinate system for the cortical surface.
